Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full bill-explainer payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Your September bill","currency":"USD","total":118.4,"dueDateText":"Due Sep 28","periodText":"Sep 1 – Sep 30","items":[{"id":"plan","label":"Unlimited Plus plan","amount":70,"category":"plan"},{"id":"device","label":"iPhone installment","amount":27.08,"category":"device"},{"id":"stream","label":"Streaming add-on","amount":9.99,"category":"streaming"},{"id":"taxes","label":"Taxes & fees","amount":11.33,"category":"taxes"}],"deltaAmount":12.4,"deltaText":"You added the Streaming add-on this cycle.","note":"Autopay is on. This amount will be charged automatically.","submitText":"Pay now","submitValue":"I'd like to pay my bill now","secondaryText":"Set up autopay","secondaryValue":"Help me set up autopay"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading at the top of the card. Defaults to 'Your bill'. - 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code (e.g. 'USD','EUR','GBP') for all amounts. Defaults to 'USD'. - 'total' (number, optional): the total amount due. When omitted it is computed by summing 'items'. - 'dueDateText' (string, optional): the due date shown as a pill, e.g. 'Due Sep 28'. - 'periodText' (string, optional): the billing period, e.g. 'Sep 1 – Sep 30'. - 'items' (array, REQUIRED, 2 to 7 objects): the itemized charges. Each MUST have 'label' (string) and 'amount' (number). Use a NEGATIVE amount, or 'category':'discount', for credits/discounts (shown in green as a credit). Optional per item: 'id' (string); 'category' (string; one of 'plan','data','device','streaming','taxes','onetime','discount','other' — drives the color used in the bar and the row dot). - 'deltaAmount' (number, optional): the change versus last month; positive means the bill went UP (tinted amber), negative means it went DOWN (tinted green). - 'deltaText' (string, optional): a short plain-language reason for the change, e.g. 'You added the Streaming add-on this cycle.' - 'note' (string, optional): a small footnote, e.g. an autopay reminder. - 'submitText' (string, optional): primary button label, e.g. 'Pay now'. Omit to hide it. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): the exact message sent back when the primary button is tapped; defaults to 'submitText'. - 'secondaryText' (string, optional): secondary button label, e.g. 'Set up autopay'. Omit to hide it. - 'secondaryValue' (string, optional): the message sent back when the secondary button is tapped; defaults to 'secondaryText'. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
